# is-redirect [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-redirect.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-redirect)

> Check if a number is a [redirect HTTP status code](http://example.invalid/wiki/List_of_HTTP_status_codes#3xx_Redirection)


## Install

```
$ npm install --save is-redirect
```


## Usage

```js
var isRedirect = require('is-redirect');

isRedirect(302);
//=> true

isRedirect(200);
//=> false
```
